title: Day 13: an AI made a cozy island game that turns into a survival night #shorts
description:
Cozy island life by day. Survival by night.

Lantern Isle is today's app in our series "AI ships an app a day": every day an AI builds a brand-new iPhone app from scratch, and we show you what it made.

By day, gather shells, driftwood, flowers and stones, and build lighthouses, lanterns and lookouts. At nightfall the same island sinks into purple mist, and everything you built becomes your light, your weapons and your friends for three minutes of auto-battling survival. Bring back glowing sand to make the island cozier, and the next night easier.

Lantern Isle - coming soon to the App Store

The music in this video was generated for this channel with Stable Audio. Narration is a synthetic voice reading our own script.

Follow for Day 14 tomorrow.

#cozygames #survivorslike #islandlife #indiegame #mobilegame
